entries.title: Psalms 61:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician upon Neginah, [A Psalm] of David.>> Hear my cry, O God; attend unto my prayer.

entries.title: Psalms 61:2
segments: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock [that] is higher than I.

entries.title: Psalms 61:3
segments: For thou hast been a shelter for me, [and] a strong tower from the enemy.

words.text: For thou hast been a shelter

entries.title: Psalms 61:4
segments: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah. {trust: or, make my refuge}

entries.title: Psalms 61:5
segments: ¶For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: thou hast given [me] the heritage of those that fear thy name.

entries.title: Psalms 61:6
segments: Thou wilt prolong the king's life: [and] his years as many generations. {Thou...: Heb. Thou shalt add days to the days of the king} {as...: Heb. as generation and generation}

words.text: . {Thou...: Heb. Thou shalt add days to the days of the king} {as...: Heb. as generation and generation}

entries.title: Psalms 61:7
segments: He shall abide before God for ever: O prepare mercy and truth, [which] may preserve him.

entries.title: Psalms 61:8
segments: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.
